newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZCCM Oct copper output plunges.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM Oct copper output plunges.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd (ZCCM) said on Friday its copper production plunged to 18,337 tonnes in October from 30,346 tonnes in September due to operational problems at the company's Nkana smelter.
ZCCM said October's production was the lowest in at least two years.
"The low production of copper was mainly due to poor operations at the Nkana smelter during the month following the shutdown of the Nkana oxygen plant for maintenance," a ZCCM spokesman said.
"The October copper production deficit has interrupted an otherwise healthy production schedule so far recorded in the financial year.
"Monthly finished copper production has been above target since the beginning of the financial year," the spokesman added.
Copper production this year peaked at 32,407 tonnes in March.
Production of cobalt also dropped considerably.
The company said October production was 243, down from the 456 tonnes in September.
But the spokesman said October's cobalt production still exceeded the company's target of 211 tonnes set for the month.
